mentions.name: Flare
mentions.description: This app for people with chronic skin conditions like eczema and rosacea lets users log symptoms and triggers, with a larger vision of discovering patterns in their own data and answering questions such as whether flare-ups correlate with stress or which foods make symptoms worse.
mentions.problem: People with chronic skin conditions have difficulty connecting their flare-ups to potential triggers like stress or diet.
mentions.audience: People with chronic skin conditions such as eczema and rosacea
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building Flare (https://www.getflare.app/), an app for people with chronic skin conditions (eczema, rosacea, etc).
